sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是罪案实录档期的新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: In the early hours of the 18th of November 2011, a fire was deliberately lit at the Quakers Hill Nursing Home in Sydney's northweSt.
sentences.zh: 2011年11月18日凌晨，悉尼西北部的贵格山疗养院被人蓄意纵火。

sentences.en: The nursing home housed 89 residents.
sentences.zh: 这家疗养院当时收住了89名老人。

sentences.en: A lot were high-dependent patients who were immobile, suffering from Alzheimer's and dementia.
sentences.zh: 其中许多是行动不便、患有阿兹海默症和痴呆症的重度依赖患者。

sentences.en: The fire killed 11 residents.
sentences.zh: 这场大火导致11名院民丧生。

sentences.en: A further 8 residents were seriously injured from burns and smoke inhalation, but survived.
sentences.zh: 另有8名院民因烧伤和吸入浓烟而重伤，但幸存了下来。

sentences.en: The case is one of Australia's worst-ever mass murders, committed by a registered nurse, Roger Dean.
sentences.zh: 这起案件是澳大利亚历史上最恶劣的集体谋杀案之一，凶手是一名注册护士罗杰·迪恩。

sentences.en: The person who was in charge of the nursing home that night.
sentences.zh: 也就是那天晚上负责管理疗养院的人。

sentences.en: The person who was supposed to be caring for the residents.
sentences.zh: 一个理应照顾这些院民的人。

sentences.en: But he didn't care about anyone but himself.
sentences.zh: 但他关心的只有他自己。

sentences.en: He was trying to cover up another crime that he had committed.
sentences.zh: 他企图掩盖自己犯下的另一起罪行。

sentences.en: Quakers Hill Nursing Home is an aged care facility caring for up to 100 residents that require a high need of care and full assistance with daily living activities.
sentences.zh: 贵格山疗养院是一家老年护理机构，最多可收容100名需要高度护理和日常起居全方位协助的院民。

sentences.en: The home has 35 separate rooms, each containing a number of beds.
sentences.zh: 该疗养院有35个独立的房间，每个房间都有数量不等的床位。

sentences.en: The nursing home is built into a large H-shape and is divided into four wings.
sentences.zh: 疗养院建筑呈巨大的H形，分为四个翼楼。

sentences.en: Wing A1, Wing A2, Wing B1 and Wing B2.
sentences.zh: A1翼楼、A2翼楼、B1翼楼和B2翼楼。

sentences.en: Wing A1 contained 8 rooMs.
sentences.zh: A1翼楼有8个房间。

sentences.en: Wing A2 had 8 rooms and 2 double rooMs.
sentences.zh: A2翼楼有8个房间和2个双人房间。

sentences.en: Wing B2 had 6 rooms with 1 double room.
sentences.zh: B2翼楼有6个房间和一个双人房间。

sentences.en: And each room contained 4 beds.
sentences.zh: 每个房间都有4张床。

sentences.en: The external doors, including the main entrance to the nursing home, were kept locked.
sentences.zh: 外部门（包括疗养院的正门）都是锁着的。

sentences.en: Entry required a PIN number on a keypad.
sentences.zh: 进出需要在键盘上输入密码。

sentences.en: There was a different code for day and night.
sentences.zh: 白天和晚上的密码各不相同。

sentences.en: The day code was available to staff and to some relatives.
sentences.zh: 白天的密码对员工和部分亲属开放。

sentences.en: But at 8pm each night the code changed.
sentences.zh: 但每天晚上8点密码会更改。

sentences.en: And that night time code was only available to staff members.
sentences.zh: 而且夜间密码只有员工才知道。

sentences.en: The nursing home contained 16 CCTV cameras in total.
sentences.zh: 疗养院总共安装了16个闭路电视摄像头。

sentences.en: Cameras were located both internally and externally.
sentences.zh: 摄像头在室内和室外都有安装。

sentences.en: The cameras were motion activated.
sentences.zh: 这些摄像头是动作感应的。

sentences.en: And each time the camera was activated, the time was recorded.
sentences.zh: 每次摄像头被触发时，系统都会记录时间。

sentences.en: There were 89 residents living in the nursing home at the time of the fire.
sentences.zh: 火灾发生时，疗养院内住着89名院民。

sentences.en: Many of the residents were bedridden and suffered from dementia and Alzheimer's disease.
sentences.zh: 许多院民长期卧床，患有痴呆症和阿兹海默症。

sentences.en: Many needed assistance with day-to-day living.
sentences.zh: 许多人需要日常生活方面的协助。

sentences.en: In early September 2011, a new nurse commenced employment at the Quakers Hill nursing home to work the night shift on Wednesday and Thursday nights.
sentences.zh: 2011年9月上旬，一名新护士开始在贵格山疗养院工作，负责周三和周四的夜班。

sentences.en: That nurse was Roger Dean.
sentences.zh: 那名护士就是罗杰·迪恩。

sentences.en: Roger Dean was 35 years old.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩今年35岁。

sentences.en: He was born in Vietnam and arrived in Australia as an infant with his mother and three other siblings.
sentences.zh: 他出生于越南，在婴儿时期随母亲和另外三个兄弟姐妹来到澳大利亚。

sentences.en: They arrived to Australia as refugees.
sentences.zh: 他们作为难民来到澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Their father died whilst trying to flee Vietnam at a later date.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们的父亲在试图逃离越南时不幸身亡。

sentences.en: Roger was homosexual and he recognised and identified with his sexual orientation from an early age.
sentences.zh: 罗杰是一名同性恋，他很早就认识并认同了自己的性取向。

sentences.en: This resulted in him being socially isolated at school and the victim of excessive bullying.
sentences.zh: 这导致他在学校被孤立，并遭受了严重的霸凌。

sentences.en: In his mid-teens he was actually physically and sexually assaulted by two adult men.
sentences.zh: 在他十五岁左右的时候，他甚至遭到过两名成年男子的身体和性侵害。

sentences.en: He had an open homosexual relationship by the age of 18 and this ignited a rift between Roger and his family.
sentences.zh: 他在18岁时就有了公开的同性恋恋爱关系，这导致罗杰与家人之间产生了裂痕。

sentences.en: He had little to no contact with his siblings throughout his adult life and his relationship with his mother has been strained.
sentences.zh: 在成年后的生活中，他与兄弟姐妹几乎没有联系，与母亲的关系也很紧张。

sentences.en: They did not approve of Roger's homosexual lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 他们不赞成罗杰的同性恋生活方式。

sentences.en: Roger graduated from the University of Sydney with a Bachelor of Nursing degree in 1996.
sentences.zh: 1996年，罗杰毕业于悉尼大学，获得护理学学士学位。

sentences.en: He worked as a nurse at both the St George Hospital, south of Sydney, and the St John of God Hospital in Burwood, which is in Sydney's weSt.
sentences.zh: 他曾先后在悉尼南部的圣乔治医院和悉尼西部落户伯伍德的圣若望神病院担任护士。

sentences.en: In 2004, he started a law degree at Macquarie University while still working as a nurse.
sentences.zh: 2004年，他在继续当护士的同时，开始在麦考瑞大学攻读法律学位。

sentences.en: This had an adverse effect on his in-work relationships and resulted in numerous arguments with fellow staff members.
sentences.zh: 这对他职场上的人际关系产生了负面影响，并导致他与同事多次发生争执。

sentences.en: The law degree, combined with his employment and shift work, was having an adverse effect on his sleeping patterns.
sentences.zh: 法律学位加上工作和轮班，对他的睡眠模式产生了负面影响。

sentences.en: Not long after this, Roger was diagnosed with Irritable Bowel Syndrome and was prescribed benzodiazepines.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，罗杰被诊断出患有肠易激综合征，并被开具了苯二氮卓类药物。

sentences.en: This drug is like a tranquiliser, which is prescribed for anxiety and sleeping probleMs.
sentences.zh: 这种药物类似于镇静剂，是用来治疗焦虑和睡眠问题的。

sentences.en: By 2007, he was no longer using the drug for what it was prescribed for.
sentences.zh: 到了2007年，他已经不再按医嘱使用这种药物了。

sentences.en: He was abusing it, using it for recreational purposes.
sentences.zh: 他在滥用药物，将其用于娱乐目的。

sentences.en: In 2008, one of Roger's close friends committed suicide, which escalated his misuse of prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 2008年，罗杰的一位挚友自杀身亡，这加剧了他对处方药的滥用。

sentences.en: Roger used to go doctor shopping and stockpiled a list of prescription medications.
sentences.zh: 罗杰过去常常辗转于各大诊所求医问药，并囤积了一大批处方药。

sentences.en: Not just benzos, but also sleeping tablets, painkillers, antidepressants, antipsychotic medication,
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是安定类药物，还有安眠药、止痛药、抗抑郁药、抗精神病药物、

sentences.en: antibiotics and penicillin, nausea medication, high blood meds, asthma meds, the list went on and on.
sentences.zh: 抗生素和青霉素、止吐药、降压药、哮喘药，诸如此类，不胜枚举。

sentences.en: He used to store the medications in his kitchen pantry in two separate Tupperware containers.
sentences.zh: 他过去把这些药物放在厨房食品储藏室的两个独立的特百惠容器里。

sentences.en: At the time of his arrest, he had about 43 different prescription drugs at his home and he was taking about 15 tablets per day.
sentences.zh: 在他被捕时，他家里大约有43种不同的处方药，他每天大约要吃15片药。

sentences.en: Roger resided in Walker Street, Quakers Hill, within walking distance to the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 罗杰住在贵格山沃克街，距离疗养院步行可达。

sentences.en: He lived there with his former partner, a Mr. French.
sentences.zh: 他与前伴侣弗伦奇先生一起住在那里。

sentences.en: There's differing reports as to whether or not they were still partners or they were ex-partners and now just flatmates, but regardless, they lived there together.
sentences.zh: 关于他们是依然是伴侣还是已经分手现在只是合租室友，有不同的说法，但无论如何，他们确实住在一起。

sentences.en: Roger had a serious problem with prescription medication.
sentences.zh: 罗杰对处方药有严重的依赖问题。

sentences.en: In June 2011, only three months before commencing employment at Quakers Hill Nursing Home,
sentences.zh: 2011年6月，就在开始贵格山疗养院工作的前三个月，

sentences.en: Roger was found drug-affected whilst on duty at the St. John of God Hospital.
sentences.zh: 罗杰在圣若望神病院值班时被发现处于药物影响状态。

sentences.en: He couldn't talk properly, could hardly walk, he was uncoordinated, he was spitting, couldn't understand basic requests.
sentences.zh: 他说话说不清楚，几乎走不动路，动作不协调，口齿不清，无法理解简单的要求。

sentences.en: He was sent home from work and immediately suspended.
sentences.zh: 他被遣送回家并立即停职。

sentences.en: In the review over that incident, he claimed to suffer from bipolar and depression and he blamed the incident at work on his GP, who had recently changed his medication.
sentences.zh: 在对该事件的审查中，他声称自己患有双相情感障碍和抑郁症，并将工作中的事故归咎于他的全科医生，因为对方最近刚给他换了药。

sentences.en: He obtained a signed note from his GP confirming he suffered bipolar and depression and recently had the medication change, explaining his behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他从全科医生那里开具了一张签字便条，证实他患有双相情感障碍和抑郁症，且最近更换过药物，以此来解释他的行为。

sentences.en: The GP declared him fit and well to return to work.
sentences.zh: 全科医生宣布他身体状况良好，可以重返工作岗位。

sentences.en: Shortly after this, Roger Dean was informed by his supervisor at St. John of God Hospital
sentences.zh: 不久之后，罗杰·迪恩接到圣若望神病院主管的通知，

sentences.en: that he was to be taken off night shifts and placed on day shifts so he could be properly supervised.
sentences.zh: 他将被取消夜班，转为白班，以便接受适当的监督。

sentences.en: They didn't trust him.
sentences.zh: 他们不信任他。

sentences.en: They also believed he had a poor ability to communicate and to manage relationships with others,
sentences.zh: 他们还认为他的沟通能力和人际交往能力较差，

sentences.en: which aren't good qualities for a registered nurse.
sentences.zh: 这些都不是注册护士应有的良好素质。

sentences.en: Roger resigned from St. John of God Hospital in September and as he only lived nearby to Quakers Hill Nursing Home, he walked down there and asked if they had any work going.
sentences.zh: 罗杰于9月份从圣若望神病院辞职，由于他住在贵格山疗养院附近，便步行过去询问那里是否有空缺。

sentences.en: And they said they did.
sentences.zh: 他们说正好有。

sentences.en: They needed a registered nurse to cover Wednesday and Thursday night shifts.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一名注册护士来顶替周三和周四的夜班。

sentences.en: Roger gave them his resume, but he never made mention of his employment at St. John of God Hospital.
sentences.zh: 罗杰交上了简历，但绝口不提自己在圣若望神病院的工作经历。

sentences.en: He said his last employment as a nurse was at St. George Hospital in 2007 and since that time he had worked in a cheesecake shop.
sentences.zh: 他说自己作为护士的上一份工作是在2007年的圣乔治医院，此后一直在一家芝士蛋糕店工作。

sentences.en: He also produced the no recent references.
sentences.zh: 他也拿不出最近的推荐信。

sentences.en: But it didn't really matter anyway because no one at Quakers Hill Nursing Home contacted any of his references or previous employers.
sentences.zh: 但这其实也无所谓，因为贵格山疗养院的任何人都没有联系他的推荐人或前雇主。

sentences.en: He was hired based on his resume, which was misleading and a quick interview.
sentences.zh: 他们根据他那份具有误导性的简历和一次简短的面试就录用了他。

sentences.en: So they had no idea about his poor recent history at St. John of God Hospital and the fact that they didn't trust him there.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们对他在圣若望神病院糟糕的近期历史以及那里不信任他的事实一无所知。

sentences.en: So he got his start at Quakers Hill Nursing Home in early September 2011 to work Wednesday and Thursday nights
sentences.zh: 于是，他在2011年9月上旬开始在贵格山疗养院上班，负责周三和周四的夜班，

sentences.en: when if there were better systems in place, he should never have been given the job.
sentences.zh: 然而如果当时有更好的制度，他本绝不应该被录用。

sentences.en: He should never have been allowed anywhere near the residence of the Quakers Hill Nursing Home or anywhere else for that matter.
sentences.zh: 本不该允许他靠近贵格山疗养院的任何院民，甚至不应该让他靠近任何其他地方。

sentences.en: On the 6th of September 2011, only days after commencing employment, a local fire station officer delivered a training course at the nursing home titled
sentences.zh: 2011年9月6日，也就是他开始工作几天后，当地消防站的一名官员在疗养院举办了一场培训课程，主题是

sentences.en: Fire Safety in Healthcare Facilities.
sentences.zh: 《医疗保健设施中的消防安全》。

sentences.en: Roger attended that course.
sentences.zh: 罗杰参加了那门课程。

sentences.en: The course included a walk around the nursing home indicating the location of all installed firefighting equipment and the location of the fire and smoke doors,
sentences.zh: 课程包括参观疗养院，指出所有已安装消防设备的地点以及防火门和防烟门的位置，

sentences.en: as well as the differences between them and how they function.
sentences.zh: 以及它们之间的区别和运作方式。

sentences.en: The fire doors were designed to automatically close upon activation of the fire alarm to contain a fire within the wing that it had started.
sentences.zh: 防火门旨在火灾警报触发时自动关闭，以便将火灾控制在起火的翼楼内。

sentences.en: The fire officer also explained the purpose of the fire indicator panel and the emergency warning system.
sentences.zh: 消防官员还解释了火灾显示盘和紧急预警系统的用途。

sentences.en: As well as doctor shopping, Roger Dean developed another method of obtaining prescription medication.
sentences.zh: 除了辗转各诊所开药外，罗杰·迪恩还开发了另一种获取处方药的方法。

sentences.en: by stealing it from the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 那就是从疗养院偷窃。

sentences.en: All of the Schedule 8 drugs were stored and dispensed under strict protocols.
sentences.zh: 所有的附表8类药物都在严格的规程下储存和分发。

sentences.en: There were regular audits to ensure all were accounted for.
sentences.zh: 有定期审计以确保所有药物都有据可查。

sentences.en: Schedule 8 drugs are prescription-based drugs that have a recognised therapeutic need, but also a higher risk of misuse, abuse and dependence.
sentences.zh: 附表8类药物是指具有公认治疗需求但误用、滥用和依赖风险较高的处方药。

sentences.en: So we're talking about things like oxy, endone, codeine, methadone and a lot more.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论的是诸如羟考酮、恩东、可待因、美沙酮等更多的药物。

sentences.en: Basically a lot of the stuff Roger Dean was addicted to.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是罗杰·迪恩上瘾的很多东西。

sentences.en: The Schedule 8 drugs were stored in a treatment room in the central part of B wing, between section B1 and section B2.
sentences.zh: 附表8类药物存放在B翼中心部位、B1区和B2区之间的治疗室内。

sentences.en: Despite being a treatment room, it was never used to treat patients.
sentences.zh: 尽管被称为治疗室，但它从未被用于治疗患者。

sentences.en: It was just the drug room.
sentences.zh: 它只是药房。

sentences.en: The drugs were stored in a locked cupboard within that room and the door to the room itself was always kept locked.
sentences.zh: 药物存放在该房间内的一个带锁柜子里，房间本身的门也始终保持锁闭状态。

sentences.en: The door to the treatment room could only be opened by a key on a blue lanyard and the locked cupboard that housed the Schedule 8 drugs inside
sentences.zh: 治疗室的门只能用挂在蓝色挂绳上的钥匙打开，里面存放附表8类药物的带锁柜子

sentences.en: could only be opened by a key on a red lanyard.
sentences.zh: 只能用挂在红色挂绳上的钥匙打开。

sentences.en: The night shift registered nurse was always in possession of both lanyards.
sentences.zh: 夜班注册护士总是持有这两根挂绳。

sentences.en: And whenever he was at work, Roger Dean was the night shift registered nurse, meaning he had both lanyards and both keys.
sentences.zh: 只要他在上班，罗杰·迪恩就是夜班注册护士，这意味着他拥有这两根挂绳和两把钥匙。

sentences.en: But the nursing home had a strict protocol that required both the registered nurse and an assistant nurse to be present in order to access the drugs.
sentences.zh: 但疗养院有一项严格的规程，要求注册护士和助理护士同时在场才能取药。

sentences.en: So each time a Schedule 8 drug was dispensed, there was a drug register that had to be filled out.
sentences.zh: 因此，每次分发附表8类药物时，都必须填写一份药物登记表。

sentences.en: This included the patient's name, the date and time, the type of drug and how much.
sentences.zh: 这包括患者姓名、日期和时间、药物类型以及剂量。

sentences.en: Then both the registered nurse and the assistant nurse would sign the register.
sentences.zh: 然后注册护士和助理护士都要在登记表上签字。

sentences.en: An audit was conducted every day by the two registered nurses that worked the afternoon shift.
sentences.zh: 每天由上下午班的两名注册护士进行一次盘点审计。

sentences.en: So at 8pm on the 16th of November 2011, an audit of the Schedule 8 drugs was carried out by the afternoon registered nurses and all were accounted for.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2011年11月16日晚上8点，下午班的注册护士对附表8类药物进行了审计，所有药物都账目清晰。

sentences.zh: 罪案实录档期稍后回来。

sentences.en: Later that night at 10.30pm, the 16th of November,
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，11月16日晚上10点30分，

sentences.en: Roger Dean commenced his shift.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩开始了他的值班。

sentences.en: Being the registered nurse on night shift means Roger was basically in charge of the place.
sentences.zh: 作为夜班注册护士，意味着罗杰基本上负责管理那个地方。

sentences.en: Roger finished his shift at 7am on the 17th of November and during that time, he stole 237 endone tablets and one capanol tablet from the treatment room.
sentences.zh: 罗杰于11月17日上午7点结束了值班，在此期间，他从治疗室偷走了237片恩东片剂和1片卡帕诺片剂。

sentences.en: Although there is no CCTV footage inside the treatment room, there is a camera that shows entry to it
sentences.zh: 尽管治疗室内部没有闭路电视监控，但有一个摄像头拍到了通往该房间的入口，

sentences.en: and Roger Dean was captured on that footage entering and leaving the room many times.
sentences.zh: 监控拍到罗杰·迪恩多次进出该房间。

sentences.en: He would spend a considerable amount of time inside the room removing neandone tablets from their blister packs.
sentences.zh: 他会在房间里呆很长时间，把恩东片剂从泡罩包装中剥出来。

sentences.en: He tried to cover this up by placing sticky tape around the blister packs, but that fooled nobody.
sentences.zh: 他试图在泡罩包装周围贴上透明胶带以此来掩盖，但这谁也骗不过。

sentences.en: At 7.30pm, the 17th of November, the afternoon shift registered nurses completed an audit of the Schedule 8 drugs as per their daily protocol.
sentences.zh: 11月17日晚上7点30分，下午班注册护士按照每日规程对附表8类药物进行了审计。

sentences.en: They noticed the 237 endone tablets missing and the one capanol tablet missing.
sentences.zh: 他们发现少了237片恩东片剂和1片卡帕诺片剂。

sentences.en: They immediately contacted the clinical manager,
sentences.zh: 他们立即联系了临床经理，

sentences.en: Laneta Mateo, who wasn't on duty at the time, but she immediately travelled to the nursing home to double check the audit.
sentences.zh: 拉内塔·马特奥，她当时不在班，但她立即赶往疗养院复核审计情况。

sentences.en: This was a pretty serious thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件相当严重的事情。

sentences.en: Laneta Mateo confirmed the drugs were missing and at 10pm, she contacted Quakers Hill Police to make a report.
sentences.zh: 拉内塔·马特奥确认药物确实丢失了，并于晚上10点联系了贵格山警方报案。

sentences.en: Roger Dean arrived at work at 10.23pm that night.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩当晚10点23分到达工作岗位。

sentences.en: He conducted a changeover with the afternoon shift staff and they informed him about the missing drugs and that the police were on their way to take a report.
sentences.zh: 他与下午班员工进行了交接，他们告知了他药物丢失一事以及警察正赶来做笔录。

sentences.en: Roger starts to panic.
sentences.zh: 罗杰开始惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Not only is his nursing career in jeopardy, but the law degree he is studying and nearly finished will be worthless if he gets a criminal conviction.
sentences.zh: 不仅他的护理生涯岌岌可危，如果留下刑事定罪，他正在攻读且即将完成的法律学位也将化为乌有。

sentences.en: So he is on edge.
sentences.zh: 因此他感到十分焦虑不安。

sentences.en: Police arrived just after midnight.
sentences.zh: 警方在午夜刚过时抵达。

sentences.en: They were met at the door by Roger who allowed them insight.
sentences.zh: 罗杰在门口迎接了他们，并允许他们入内。

sentences.en: The police started to take a report and ask a few questions of Roger and Laneta Mateo.
sentences.zh: 警方开始做笔录，并向罗杰和拉内塔·马特奥询问了一些问题。

sentences.en: However, after 17 minutes of being on scene, they received an urgent call and they had to leave.
sentences.zh: 然而，在现场待了17分钟后，他们接到一个紧急电话，不得不离开。

sentences.en: They said they would be back as soon as they could.
sentences.zh: 他们表示会尽快返回。

sentences.en: Whilst waiting for the police to return,
sentences.zh: 在等待警方返回期间，

sentences.en: Laneta Mateo started reviewing the CCTV footage covering the treatment room and that's when she saw the only person coming and going was Roger.
sentences.zh: 拉内塔·马特奥开始查看监控录像，这些监控拍到了治疗室，就在那时她发现唯一进出的人是罗杰。

sentences.en: At 3.43am, Laneta left the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点43分，拉内塔离开了疗养院。

sentences.en: The police still hadn't arrived back and she was unable to wait any longer.
sentences.zh: 警察仍未返回，她已经无法再等下去了。

sentences.en: Laneta had compiled all the evidence of the test together.
sentences.zh: 拉内塔将所有关于检测的证据收集在了一起。

sentences.en: She had the audit documents and computer records, the CCTV footage and the empty blister packs for fingerprinting.
sentences.zh: 她掌握了审计文件和电脑记录、闭路电视录像以及用于提取指纹的空泡罩包装。

sentences.en: She kept them in her office and locked the door.
sentences.zh: 她把这些东西放在自己的办公室里，并锁上了门。

sentences.en: There were only two keys available to her office.
sentences.zh: 她的办公室只有两把可用的钥匙。

sentences.en: She had one and the facility manager had the other.
sentences.zh: 她有一把，机构经理有另一把。

sentences.en: The manager's office wouldn't be opened again until after the fire when it was opened by police.
sentences.zh: 经理的办公室直到火灾之后才再次打开，当时是由警察打开的。

sentences.en: Once Laneta had left,
sentences.zh: 一旦拉内塔离开，

sentences.en: Roger had come up with his plan to avoid getting in trouble for the drug theft.
sentences.zh: 罗杰就想出了一个计划，以避免因盗窃毒品而惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: At 4.35am,
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点35分，

sentences.en: Roger Dean requested two assistant nurses in B-Wing, who were near the treatment room, to take a break.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩要求B翼的两名护士助理（她们靠近治疗室）休息一下。

sentences.en: They declined, stating they had already had their break.
sentences.zh: 她们拒绝了，称自己已经休息过了。

sentences.en: So Roger Dean then approached two other assistant nurses over in A-Wing and told them to take a break, which they did.
sentences.zh: 于是罗杰·迪恩又走近A翼的两名护士助理，叫她们去休息，她们照做了。

sentences.en: And this left Roger alone on the ward.
sentences.zh: 这使得罗杰独自留在了病房里。

sentences.en: At 4.51am,
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点51分，

sentences.en: Roger entered Wing A-2, where there were no CCTV cameras.
sentences.zh: 罗杰进入了没有监控摄像头的A-2翼。

sentences.en: About 4.53am,
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨4点53分，

sentences.en: Roger set fire to a bed in room 19 of Wing A-2.
sentences.zh: 罗杰放火烧了A-2翼19房间的一张床。

sentences.en: He used a cigarette lighter that had been left in the kitchen by another staff member.
sentences.zh: 他用的是另一个员工留在厨房的打火机。

sentences.en: This is how he describes it.
sentences.zh: 他是这样描述的：

sentences.en: I took the lighter for the purpose of lighting.
sentences.zh: 我拿打火机是为了点东西。

sentences.en: I didn't expect to light a bed.
sentences.zh: 我没料到会点着一张床。

sentences.en: I just wanted to light something.
sentences.zh: 我只是想点燃什么东西。

sentences.en: I just wanted to set a light to something.
sentences.zh: 我只是想把什么东西点着。

sentences.en: It just so happens that there was an empty bed and I just did it to that.
sentences.zh: 碰巧那里有一张空床，我就在那上面做了。

sentences.en: The fire sensors detected the fire almost immediately and the fire alarm activated.
sentences.zh: 火灾传感器几乎立刻探测到了火情，火警警报拉响了。

sentences.en: The alarm caused a loud siren to activate and this sent an automatic message to the fire brigade.
sentences.zh: 警报器触发了响亮的警笛，并向消防部门发送了自动信息。

sentences.en: All the fire doors throughout the nursing home closed and the fire alarm panel in the foyer was activated.
sentences.zh: 疗养院内的所有防火门都关闭了，门厅里的火灾报警盘也被触发了。

sentences.en: Of course,
sentences.zh: 当然，

sentences.en: Roger was well aware of all this because he had recently attended the fire safety and healthcare facilities course.
sentences.zh: 罗杰对这一切非常清楚，因为他最近刚参加过消防安全和医疗设施课程。

sentences.en: As the fire door closed,
sentences.zh: 随着防火门关闭，

sentences.en: Roger walked from Wing A-2 towards Wing A-1.
sentences.zh: 罗杰从A-2翼走向A-1翼。

sentences.en: Roger then lit a second fire on the sheet of an unoccupied bed in room 3 of Wing A-1.
sentences.zh: 接着罗杰在A-1翼3号房的一张无人居住的床的床单上放了第二把火。

sentences.en: He used the same cigarette lighter which he then threw into a sanitary bin in the Wing A-1 bathroom.
sentences.zh: 他用了同一个打火机，然后把它扔进了A-1翼浴室的卫生垃圾桶里。

sentences.en: This is how he describes it.
sentences.zh: 他是这样描述的：

sentences.en: It started just as a small flame and I thought that that's okay.
sentences.zh: 刚开始只是一小团火焰，我还觉得没关系。

sentences.en: Like that's containable.
sentences.zh: 就像那是可以控制的。

sentences.en: I didn't expect it to be so big.
sentences.zh: 我没想到会这么大。

sentences.en: It was just something stupid and something that I wish I'd never done.
sentences.zh: 这只是一件愚蠢的事，也是我希望自己从未做过的事。

sentences.en: At 4.59am, the 1st Fire Brigade officers arrived.
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点59分，第一批消防员抵达。

sentences.en: Other staff members directed them straight to the first fire in room 19 in Wing A-2.
sentences.zh: 其他工作人员直接引导他们前往A-2翼19房间的第一起火灾。

sentences.en: They were able to extinguish that fire but they were unaware of the second fire.
sentences.zh: 他们扑灭了那场火，但并不知道还有第二起火灾。

sentences.en: There was no second alarm alerting them to the second fire.
sentences.zh: 没有第二个警报提醒他们注意第二起火灾。

sentences.en: The alarm had already gone off so as far as they were aware, room 19 was the only fire.
sentences.zh: 警报器已经响过了，据他们所知，19房间是唯一起火的地方。

sentences.en: Whilst this fire was being put out,
sentences.zh: 在这场火灾被扑灭的同时，

sentences.en: Roger Dean started to try and play hero.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩开始试图扮演英雄。

sentences.en: He grabbed a resident, Helen, from room 4 in Wing A-1, the room next door to the second fire.
sentences.zh: 他从A-1翼4号房（即第二起火灾隔壁的房间）拉出了一位名叫海伦的居民。

sentences.en: He said, come on darling, we've got to get out.
sentences.zh: 他说，来吧，亲爱的，我们得离开这里。

sentences.en: We've got to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 我们得撤离。

sentences.en: He started to walk her out of the room up the hallway to the front door.
sentences.zh: 他开始带着她走出房间，顺着走廊走向前门。

sentences.en: As they passed room 3,
sentences.zh: 当他们经过3号房时，

sentences.en: Helen looked in and saw the second fire.
sentences.zh: 海伦朝里面看去，看到了第二起火灾。

sentences.en: By this stage, the bed was well alight.
sentences.zh: 此时，床已经彻底燃烧起来了。

sentences.en: Helen broke free from Roger and ran into the room yelling, we've got to get them out, we've got to get them out.
sentences.zh: 海伦挣脱了罗杰，跑进房间大喊：我们得把他们弄出去，我们得把他们弄出去。

sentences.en: What Roger had done was lit the second fire on an unoccupied bed but there were two residents in that room on other beds,
sentences.zh: 罗杰所做的是在一张空床上放了第二把火，但那个房间的其他床上还有两位居民，

sentences.en: Dorothy Sterling and Dorothy Wu.
sentences.zh: 多萝西·斯特灵和多萝西·吴。

sentences.en: Both suffered Alzheimer's disease amongst other health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 两人都患有阿尔茨海默病以及其他健康问题。

sentences.en: Both were immobile and were unable to move without assistance.
sentences.zh: 两人都行动不便，没有协助就无法移动。

sentences.en: Roger would have been well aware of this but he just left them to die.
sentences.zh: 罗杰对此本应非常清楚，但他却任由她们去死。

sentences.en: He callously said, don't worry Helen, just leave them.
sentences.zh: 他冷酷地说：别担心，海伦，别管她们。

sentences.en: We've got to get out.
sentences.zh: 我们得出去。

sentences.en: People are on their way to get them.
sentences.zh: 有人正在路上来接她们。

sentences.en: Roger grabbed Helen and forced her out of the room.
sentences.zh: 罗杰抓起海伦，强行把她推出了房间。

sentences.en: Roger got Helen out and then divided his time between Wing A and Wing B, assisting some of the residents to get out.
sentences.zh: 罗杰把海伦带了出去，随后在A翼和B翼之间奔波，协助部分居民撤离。

sentences.en: But at no time did he tell anyone about the second fire.
sentences.zh: 但从头到尾，他都没有向任何人提起第二起火灾的事。

sentences.en: As far as the fire brigade officers and other staff members could tell, there was still only the one fire and that had been put out.
sentences.zh: 在消防员和其他工作人员看来，依然只有一场火灾，并且已经被扑灭了。

sentences.en: At 5.04am, fire brigade officers made their way into Wing A1 and it became clear to them at this point that there was actually a second fire.
sentences.zh: 凌晨5点04分，消防员进入A1翼，此时他们才清楚地发现实际上还有第二起火灾。

sentences.en: But at this stage, the fire was out of control.
sentences.zh: 但到了这个时候，火势已经失控了。

sentences.en: The heat was intense and there were excessive amounts of black smoke everywhere.
sentences.zh: 热浪逼人，到处都是滚滚的浓烟。

sentences.en: For this reason, it was difficult for them to determine where the fire was exactly.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他们很难准确判断火源的确切位置。

sentences.en: They could hear a number of residents screaming out for help.
sentences.zh: 他们能听到许多居民大声呼救。

sentences.en: In the meantime,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Roger Dean was outside safe.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩在外面安然无恙。

sentences.en: He helped move residents away from the building as they made their way outside.
sentences.zh: 当居民们撤到外面时，他帮忙引导他们远离大楼。

sentences.en: At 5.15am, fire brigade officers found the second fire in room three.
sentences.zh: 凌晨5点15分，消防员在三号房间找到了第二起火灾。

sentences.en: By this stage, the fire was breaching the roof.
sentences.zh: 此时，火势已经烧穿了屋顶。

sentences.en: It was well alight.
sentences.zh: 火势正旺。

sentences.en: They got to work on putting it out.
sentences.zh: 他们开始着手灭火。

sentences.en: They could still hear residents crying out for help.
sentences.zh: 他们依然能听到居民们的哭喊求救声。

sentences.en: The smoke and the heat were so intense, they had to crawl around on their hands and knees to try and find the residents.
sentences.zh: 烟雾和高温如此剧烈，以至于他们不得不手脚并用在地上爬行，试图寻找居民。

sentences.en: They couldn't see anything.
sentences.zh: 他们什么也看不见。

sentences.en: They were getting around more by way of touch than anything else.
sentences.zh: 他们主要靠触觉四处摸索。

sentences.en: It was a horrific scene.
sentences.zh: 那是一个恐怖的场景。

sentences.en: The residents that could move by themselves were crawling on their hands and knees to get out with the roof burning above them.
sentences.zh: 那些能够自行移动的居民头顶燃烧着屋顶，手脚并爬地逃生。

sentences.en: But then there were those residents who couldn't move without help, frail and vulnerable, just lying there waiting for someone to come and save them with the building
sentences.zh: 但还有那些没有帮助就无法移动的居民，体弱多病，只能无助地躺在那里，等待着有人来救他们，而大楼

sentences.en: burning down around them.
sentences.zh: 在他们周围熊熊燃烧。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine anyone experiencing more terror.
sentences.zh: 很难想象有人会经历比这更恐惧的事情。

sentences.en: In some cases, they were able to wheel patients out, but in other cases, they had to make do just by dragging them along the floor.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们能够把病人推着轮椅送出去，但在另一些情况下，他们只能将人直接在地板上拖拽。

sentences.en: They had to do whatever they could to get the residents out as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们必须尽一切可能以最快速度把居民救出来。

sentences.en: And once they got some residents to safety, they ran straight back into danger to get more.
sentences.zh: 一旦把一些居民转移到安全地带，他们又立刻冲回危险之中去救更多的人。

sentences.en: Fire Brigade officers did their best to get everyone out.
sentences.zh: 消防员尽了最大努力将所有人救出。

sentences.en: But not everyone could be saved.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都能被救下。

sentences.en: The fire resulted in three residents dying at the scene, another eight residents died later in hospital,
sentences.zh: 大火导致三名居民当场死亡，另外八名居民随后在医院死亡，

sentences.en: and another three died in the weeks and months after the fire.
sentences.zh: 还有三人在火灾发生后的数周和数月内死亡。

sentences.en: Outside was a horrible, horrible sight.
sentences.zh: 外面是一幅极其可怕的景象。

sentences.en: Elderly, vulnerable patients everywhere, lying in beds, lying on the ground, being attended to by ambulance officers.
sentences.zh: 到处都是虚弱的老年患者，躺在床上，躺在地上，由救护人员进行护理。

sentences.en: Beds were stacked up outside everywhere.
sentences.zh: 外面到处堆叠着病床。

sentences.en: There were police everywhere, fire brigade everywhere, onlookers everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是警察、消防员和旁观者。

sentences.en: It was estimated there were about
sentences.zh: 据估计大约有

sentences.en: 100 firefighters on scene,
sentences.zh: 100名消防员在现场，

sentences.en: 100 ambulance officers on scene, and about 75 police on scene.
sentences.zh: 100名救护人员在现场，大约75名警察在现场。

sentences.en: When you add in all of the residents and all of the onlookers and the media, the place looked more like a war zone.
sentences.zh: 如果再加上所有的居民、旁观者和媒体，这个地方看起来更像是一个战区。

sentences.en: And in amongst it all was Roger Dean, standing amongst the chaos safely outside.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切之中，罗杰·迪恩安全地站在混乱的人群中。

sentences.en: He remained outside for a while, but between 5.30am and 6.10am, he made three separate attempts to re-enter the nursing home through the front doors.
sentences.zh: 他在外面待了一会儿，但在凌晨5点30分到6点10分之间，他曾三次试图从前门重新进入疗养院。

sentences.en: He was blocked by police and fire officers the first two times, but the third time he got lucky.
sentences.zh: 前两次他被警察和消防人员拦住了，但第三次他走运了。

sentences.en: He said to a firefighter, I need to go inside to get the drug books, so I need to get in there.
sentences.zh: 他对外面的消防员说：我需要进去拿毒品记录本，所以我必须进去。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案宗档案稍后回归。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持案宗档案继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Roger showed the firefighter the two lanyards with the keys for the Schedule 8 drug room and the drug cupboard.
sentences.zh: 罗杰向消防员出示了两根挂绳，上面挂着管制药品室和药品柜的钥匙。

sentences.en: The firefighter allowed Roger to enter, but he also went with him.
sentences.zh: 消防员允许罗杰进入，但也一同跟了进去。

sentences.en: Roger went with the firefighter towards the treatment room, but Roger stopped short of where the CCTV cameras capture.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和消防员一起走向治疗室，但在监控摄像拍不到的地方停下了脚步。

sentences.en: He handed the keys to the firefighter and told him the location of the drug books inside the treatment room while he waited off camera.
sentences.zh: 他把钥匙交给了消防员，并告诉了他治疗室里毒品记录本的位置，而自己则在镜头外等待。

sentences.en: But the firefighter couldn't open the door, so he called Roger over.
sentences.zh: 但消防员打不开门，于是他把罗杰叫了过来。

sentences.en: Roger didn't go at first, he was reluctant, he was trying to call out the instructions, but eventually he had no choice.
sentences.zh: 罗杰起初没有过去，他有些抗拒，试图在远处大声喊出指令，但最终别无选择。

sentences.en: He had to walk on camera to unlock the room.
sentences.zh: 他不得不走进镜头范围内去打开房间的门。

sentences.en: He walked in the room, unlocked the drug cabinet and removed the drug audit registers, put them into his shoulder bag and then left the building.
sentences.zh: 他走进房间，打开药柜，拿走了药品审计登记册，把它们放进自己的单肩包里，然后离开了大楼。

sentences.en: As he was leaving, he said, I need to go home, I need to get Ventolin.
sentences.zh: 离开时，他说：我得回家，我得去拿万托林。

sentences.en: I live close by and I really need my Ventolin.
sentences.zh: 我住得很近，我真的很需要我的万托林。

sentences.en: But as Roger left the nursing home, he ran straight into the path of a TV reporter and camera crew and he made time for a quick interview.
sentences.zh: 然而就在罗杰离开疗养院时，他正好撞上了一名电视记者和摄像团队，并抽空接受了一个简短的采访。

sentences.en: This is what he had to say.
sentences.zh: 他是这样说的：

sentences.en: I'm Roger,
sentences.zh: 我是罗杰，

sentences.en: I'm one of the nurses and there was a fire and I just quickly just did what I can to get everyone out and the smoke is just overwhelming but,
sentences.zh: 我是这里的护士之一，当时发生了火灾，我只是迅速地尽我所能把所有人都救了出去，烟雾实在太大了，不过，

sentences.en: you know, we got a lot of people out
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们救出了很多人，

sentences.en: so that's the main thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这才是最主要的。

sentences.en: He gave that interview whilst the drug registers were still in his bag, the reason he caused the whole tragedy.
sentences.zh: 他接受采访时，毒品登记册依然在他的包里，而这正是他引发整场悲剧的原因。

sentences.en: Afterwards,
sentences.zh: 事后，

sentences.en: Roger walked home where he tore up the pages of the drug audit register.
sentences.zh: 罗杰步行回到家中，撕毁了药品审计登记册的页面。

sentences.en: He put the pages into a plastic shopping bag and then got his flatmate
sentences.zh: 他把这些纸页放进一个塑料购物袋里，然后让他的室友

sentences.en: Mr French to drive him to a shop in Douglas Road,
sentences.zh: 弗伦奇先生开车送他去道格拉斯路的一家商店，

sentences.en: Quakers Hill where he disposed of the bag in a dumpster bin.
sentences.zh: 位于贵格会山，在那里他把袋子扔进了一个大垃圾箱里。

sentences.en: Roger then got dropped off back at the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 随后罗杰被送回疗养院。

sentences.en: He was looked over by ambulance officers and was taken to Mount Druitt Hospital.
sentences.zh: 他接受了救护人员的检查，并被送往芒特德鲁特医院。

sentences.en: His condition was recorded as
sentences.zh: 记录显示他的状况为

sentences.en: presented with sooty residue on his face and clothes, pale skin and generally distressed.
sentences.zh: 面部和衣服上有烟灰残留，脸色苍白，整体情绪痛苦。

sentences.en: About 2pm he was released from hospital and was taken to Mount Druitt Police Station where he made a statement.
sentences.zh: 大约下午2点，他从医院出院，被带到芒特德鲁特警察局做笔录。

sentences.en: He made no admissions in that statement.
sentences.zh: 他在那份笔录中没有做任何承认。

sentences.en: He just accounted for his actions on the night minus the part about lighting the fires.
sentences.zh: 他只是交代了当晚自己的行踪，唯独隐瞒了放火的那部分。

sentences.en: Shortly after making the statement he was told by police he was a suspect.
sentences.zh: 做完笔录不久，警方告知他是一名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: It's hard to understand what Roger was hoping to achieve by starting this fire.
sentences.zh: 很难理解罗杰放这场火究竟希望达到什么目的。

sentences.en: We know it was done to try and cover up the fact he stole the drugs but it covered up nothing.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这是为了掩盖他偷窃毒品的事实，但这什么也没掩盖掉。

sentences.en: Lanetta, the clinical manager had already reviewed the CCTV footage and had all the evidence stored in her locked office.
sentences.zh: 临床经理拉内塔已经查看了监控录像，并将所有证据存放在她上锁的办公室里。

sentences.en: Roger was the only one done with keys the night the drugs were stolen and he was the only one entering the room on the CCTV footage.
sentences.zh: 在毒品被盗的那晚，罗杰是唯一拥有钥匙的人，而且在监控录像中，他是唯一进入该房间的人。

sentences.en: The footage was still intact and wasn't damaged by the fire at all.
sentences.zh: 录像依然完好无损，完全没有被大火损坏。

sentences.en: So not only did it show him stealing the drugs it also showed the far more serious offence of him being responsible for lighting the fires.
sentences.zh: 因此，它不仅拍到了他偷窃毒品，还拍到了他作为纵火罪魁祸首这一更为严重的罪行。

sentences.en: The actual act themselves weren't captured they were off camera but it wasn't hard to work out who was responsible.
sentences.zh: 虽然纵火的实际行为没有被拍到，它们在镜头之外，但要查清是谁干的并不难。

sentences.en: He was the only one on camera going to the locations of the fires.
sentences.zh: 他是唯一一个出现在镜头中前往起火地点的。

sentences.en: Police had their man pretty much straight away.
sentences.zh: 警方很快就锁定了嫌疑人。

sentences.en: There was no long drawn out investigation in fact when he was told by police he was a suspect they already had his telephone tapped and he made a call straight away to Mr. French.
sentences.zh: 没有漫长的调查，事实上，当警察告诉他他是嫌疑人时，他们已经监听了他的电话，他立刻给弗伦奇先生打了个电话。

sentences.en: He told him what was going on.
sentences.zh: 他把情况告诉了他。

sentences.en: He then called two friends
sentences.zh: 然后他给两个朋友打了电话

sentences.en: Mr. and Mrs. Reid who attended the police station to speak with him in private
sentences.zh: 里德夫妇，他们来到警察局与他私下交谈

sentences.en: and while speaking to them he came clean and made full admissions to lighting the fires.
sentences.zh: 在与他们交谈时，他坦白了，并完全承认了纵火的事实。

sentences.en: Roger Dean was arrested at 7.50pm.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩于晚上7点50分被捕。

sentences.en: A lot of the residents killed were unable to move independently.
sentences.zh: 许多遇难居民无法独立行动。

sentences.en: A worse fate is difficult to imagine.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的命运难以想象。

sentences.en: Knowing a fire is raging and not being able to move or do anything about it just lying there waiting to be either burnt alive or to be suffocated by smoke.
sentences.zh: 明知大火肆虐却无法动弹或无能为力，只能躺在那里等待被活活烧死或被浓烟窒息。

sentences.en: All the victims were vulnerable and were under
sentences.zh: 所有的受害者都是弱势群体，并且处于

sentences.en: Roger's direct care.
sentences.zh: 罗杰的直接照料之下。

sentences.en: He was the registered nurse in charge at the night shift.
sentences.zh: 他是夜班负责的注册护士。

sentences.en: He knew those patients in that room where he lit the second fire were immobile and he refused to help them telling Helen don't worry someone else is coming but he knew
sentences.zh: 他知道他放第二把火的那个房间里的病人行动不便，但他拒绝帮助他们，告诉海伦别担心，会有人来的，但他知道

sentences.en: no one else was coming because they didn't know about the second fire and he didn't tell anyone about it.
sentences.zh: 根本没有人会来，因为他们不知道第二场火灾，而且他没有告诉任何人。

sentences.en: Despite this he claims that he never intended to hurt anybody.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他坚称自己从未想过伤害任何人。

sentences.en: He didn't think the fires would get out of control.
sentences.zh: 他以为火势不会失控。

sentences.en: He thought they would be contained but his actions tell a different story.
sentences.zh: 他以为火势能被控制住，但他的行动说明了另一回事。

sentences.en: There was premeditation and planning.
sentences.zh: 这是蓄意和有计划的。

sentences.en: He asked the two assistant nurses to leave the wing.
sentences.zh: 他要求两名护士助理离开侧翼病区。

sentences.en: He had planned this with one main objective to deflect attention away from the stolen drugs.
sentences.zh: 他策划这一切只有一个主要目的，那就是转移人们对被盗药品的注意力。

sentences.en: It's been thought since that Roger was mistreating patients before the fire doing things like giving them no-dose tablets or generic over-the-counter paracetamol tablets
sentences.zh: 人们后来认为，罗杰在火灾前就一直在虐待病人，比如给他们服用无剂量药片或通用的非处方扑热息痛片

sentences.en: instead of their prescribed pain medication which he would instead keep for himself.
sentences.zh: 而不是他们处方中的止痛药，这些止痛药被他据为己有。

sentences.en: Other staff members had already complained about Roger Dean's behaviour at the nursing home but nothing had been done.
sentences.zh: 其他员工此前已经抱怨过罗杰·迪恩在疗养院的行为，但什么也没做。

sentences.en: Roger tried to shift accountability away from himself by placing the blame on prescription drugs and a psychiatric illness and even the devil.
sentences.zh: 罗杰试图将责任从自己身上推开，把罪责归咎于处方药、精神疾病甚至魔鬼。

sentences.en: You won't believe it but it was like Satan
sentences.zh: 你不会相信，但感觉就像是撒旦

sentences.en: saying to me that it's the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 在对我说，这是正确的事。

sentences.en: The grounds of placing blame on the prescription drug addiction, a psych illness,
sentences.zh: 将责任归咎于处方药瘾、精神疾病、

sentences.en: Satan or whatever else were rejected.
sentences.zh: 撒旦或其他什么的理由都被驳回了。

sentences.en: Roger displayed no obvious impairment to his reasoning, communication skills or physical function during his television interview just after the incident or during his
sentences.zh: 在事发后不久的电视采访中，或者在

sentences.en: police interview later that night.
sentences.zh: 当晚晚些时候的警方采访中，罗杰的推理能力、沟通能力或身体机能均未表现出明显的受损。

sentences.en: Doctors rejected any notion of a psychiatric illness.
sentences.zh: 医生们驳回了任何精神疾病的说法。

sentences.en: After an evaluation
sentences.zh: 经过评估

sentences.en: Roger was determined to show narcissistic personality traits with an unusually strong desire to please people.
sentences.zh: 罗杰被认定表现出自恋型人格特征，具有异常强烈的取悦他人的愿望。

sentences.en: He also was found to have a strong sense of entitlement, an assumption of superiority.
sentences.zh: 人们还发现他有强烈的特权意识和优越感。

sentences.en: He disregarded the needs of others, dismissed criticism and refused to take advice and instruction.
sentences.zh: 他忽视他人的需求，对批评不屑一顾，并拒绝接受建议和指导。

sentences.en: The very fact he committed the crime to cover up the drug theft shows he was of sound mind.
sentences.zh: 他为了掩盖盗药而犯罪这一事实本身，就表明他精神正常。

sentences.en: He had no impaired capacity from drugs or a psych illness and he didn't receive instructions from Satan.
sentences.zh: 他没有因药物或精神疾病而导致能力受损，也没有接受来自撒旦的指示。

sentences.en: The reason to light the fires was out of pure self-intereSt.
sentences.zh: 纵火的原因纯粹是出于自私。

sentences.en: He knew his career in nursing and any future career in law would be gone if he was convicted of stealing drugs.
sentences.zh: 他知道，如果他被判盗窃药品罪，他的护理生涯和未来任何法律职业生涯都将不复存在。

sentences.en: Roger initially elected to have the charges go to trial and he requested to have the matter tried in front of a judge only, no jury, but this application was thrown out
sentences.zh: 罗杰最初选择接受审理，并要求由法官而非陪审团单独审理此案，但这一申请被驳回了

sentences.en: and as a result
sentences.zh: 因此

sentences.en: Roger elected not to go to trial.
sentences.zh: 罗杰选择放弃审判。

sentences.en: Instead, on the 27th of May
sentences.zh: 相反，在5月27日

sentences.en: 2013 in the New South
sentences.zh: 2013年，在新南威尔士州

sentences.en: Wales Supreme Court he pled guilty to 11 counts of murder.
sentences.zh: 最高法院，他对11项谋杀罪名表示认罪。

sentences.en: He also pled guilty to 8 counts of recklessly caused grievous bodily harm.
sentences.zh: 他还对8项鲁莽造成严重身体伤害的罪名表示认罪。

sentences.en: He also pleaded guilty to stealing the Schedule 8 drugs.
sentences.zh: 他还承认了盗窃附表8药品的罪行。

sentences.en: The 11 lives he took that night were Dorothy Sterling,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上他夺走的11条生命是多萝西·斯特林，

sentences.en: Dorothy Wu,
sentences.zh: 多萝西·吴，

sentences.en: Alma Smith,
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛·史密斯，

sentences.en: Lola Bennett,
sentences.zh: 罗拉·贝内特，

sentences.en: Ella Wood,
sentences.zh: 艾拉·伍德，

sentences.en: Urbana Alipio,
sentences.zh: 乌尔巴纳·阿利皮奥，

sentences.en: Cesar Gilear,
sentences.zh: 塞萨尔·吉利尔，

sentences.en: Doris Beck,
sentences.zh: 多丽丝·贝克，

sentences.en: Reginald William Green,
sentences.zh: 雷金纳德·威廉·格林，

sentences.en: Werner Webeck and Nilt J.
sentences.zh: 韦纳·维贝克以及尼尔特·J·

sentences.en: Valquet.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔奎特。

sentences.en: Roger was also responsible for the deaths of three other people that he was never charged with murder for.
sentences.zh: 罗杰还对另外三个人的死亡负有责任，但他从未因此被控谋杀。

sentences.en: They couldn't exactly pin the deaths directly to him.
sentences.zh: 他们无法确切地将这些人的死直接归咎于他。

sentences.en: They lost their lives a bit later on but I think you can say he was responsible.
sentences.zh: 他们稍后才丧生，但我认为你可以说他难辞其咎。

sentences.en: Esther Newman's death was deemed to be due to age and natural causes however she suffered smoke inhalation that night and was in hospital.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特·纽曼的死被认为是由年龄和自然原因引起的，然而她当晚遭遇了吸入性浓烟并在医院接受治疗。

sentences.en: Joan Joy's death was ruled due to age and natural causes however she suffered stress as she had to be disconnected from her dialysis machine during the evacuation.
sentences.zh: 琼·乔伊的死被裁定为年龄和自然原因所致，然而她在疏散过程中被迫断开透析机，承受了巨大的压力。

sentences.en: Emanuela Kachia died from an infection acquired in hospital after being admitted as she was suffering from smoke inhalation.
sentences.zh: 埃马努埃拉·卡基亚因吸入浓烟入院后在医院感染去世。

sentences.en: It was found that the late guilty pleas were made out of a realisation on Roger's part that there was overwhelming and damning evidence of his guilt and overwhelming
sentences.zh: 人们发现，较晚的认罪是由于罗杰意识到有压倒性且确凿的证据证明他的罪行，以及压倒性

sentences.en: and damning evidence he committed to crimes whilst in a lucid and rational state.
sentences.zh: 且确凿的证据表明他在头脑清醒和理智的状态下犯下了罪行。

sentences.en: He didn't plead guilty due to any remorse.
sentences.zh: 他认罪并非出于任何悔意。

sentences.en: On the 1st of August
sentences.zh: 在8月1日

sentences.en: 2013 in the NSW
sentences.zh: 2013年，在新州

sentences.en: Supreme Court
sentences.zh: 最高法院

sentences.en: Roger Dean was sentenced to life in prison for each murder charge.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·迪恩对每项谋杀罪名都被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: He was also given jail time for the eight counts of recklessly inflicted grievous bodily harm and for stealing the drugs.
sentences.zh: 他还因八项鲁莽造成严重身体伤害罪和盗窃药品罪而被判处监禁。

sentences.en: But by the time those sentences expire he will still be in custody on the murder charges.
sentences.zh: 但等到这些刑期结束时，他仍将因谋杀罪而被羁押。

sentences.en: He's never getting out.
sentences.zh: 他永远别想出来。

sentences.en: Roger showed no emotion at all when his life sentence was read out.
sentences.zh: 当宣读他的终身监禁判决时，罗杰没有表现出任何情绪。

sentences.en: He just stared blankly straight ahead before being taken away to spend the rest of his life behind bars.
sentences.zh: 他只是面无表情地直视前方，然后被带走，在铁窗后度过余生。

sentences.en: Victims' family members in the court yelled out and applauded at the sentence.
sentences.zh: 法庭内的受害者家属对这一判决大声叫好并鼓掌。

sentences.en: It was fitting he was giving a life sentence.
sentences.zh: 判处他终身监禁是罪有应得。

sentences.en: Not only did he take 11 lives he handed all the family members a life sentence as well.
sentences.zh: 他不仅夺走了11条生命，也给所有家属判处了终身监禁。

sentences.en: They thought they were doing the right thing sending their family members to a nursing home.
sentences.zh: 他们以为把家人送到疗养院是在做正确的事。

sentences.en: It was supposed to be a safe place.
sentences.zh: 那本该是一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: A place where they would be well cared for and well looked after.
sentences.zh: 一个能让他们得到良好照顾和妥善照料的地方。

sentences.en: Not a place where they were supposed to be put in danger by a complete psychopath.
sentences.zh: 而不是一个会被彻头彻尾的精神病患者置于危险之中的地方。

sentences.en: The fact that so many residents required assistance with day-to-day living and just moving around in general and the fact many suffered dementia and Alzheimer's
sentences.zh: 许多居民在日常生活甚至日常移动方面都需要协助，而且许多人患有痴呆症和阿尔茨海默病，这一事实

sentences.en: significantly complicated the rescue effort and was a factor in the scale of the disaster.
sentences.zh: 大大复杂化了救援工作，也是这场灾难规模巨大的一个因素。

sentences.en: No one knew just how vulnerable the residents were better than Roger Dean.
sentences.zh: 没有人比罗杰·迪恩更清楚居民们的处境是多么脆弱。

sentences.en: Whilst in jail
sentences.zh: 在狱中

sentences.en: Roger has suffered degrading and distressing behaviour at the hands of other inmates.
sentences.zh: 罗杰遭受了其他犯人对其实施的羞辱和痛苦的行为。

sentences.en: His reputation has required the need for him to be put into protective custody.
sentences.zh: 他的名声使得他必须被置于保护性拘留之下。

sentences.en: Roger later appealed life sentences saying they were excessive and that he could not have foreseen the extent of the damage and loss of life that occurred when he lit the fires.
sentences.zh: 罗杰后来对终身监禁提出上诉，称量刑过重，并且他在纵火时无法预料到所造成的损害和生命损失程度。

sentences.en: He also argued that his long-term addiction to prescription medication and his alleged personality disorder slash psychiatric illness and the effect that those had
sentences.zh: 他还辩称，他在量刑时未将长期药瘾、所谓的个性障壁斜杠精神疾病以及这些因素

sentences.en: on his decision-making were not taken into account during the sentencing.
sentences.zh: 对其决策的影响考虑在内。

sentences.en: Thankfully, this appeal was rejected.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，这一上诉被驳回了。
